entries.text: Hello, hello. I hope everyone’s ready to learn\nsome new things today![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_01

entries.text: You all did really great on the midterm exam![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_02

entries.text: Thanks for answering my little question at the\nend, too.\c\nI’ll be sure to keep your responses in mind.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_03

entries.text: All right! We’re now heading into the last half\nof our classes together.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_04

entries.text: It’s time for our knowledge to evolve and grow—\njust like our Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_05

entries.text: Evolution...yep. Haha! Evolution![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_06

entries.text: Today we’re going to learn about the fascinating\nphenomenon of Pokémon Evolution![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_07

entries.text: As your Pokémon battle and level up, they learn\nmoves and get stronger.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_08

entries.text: And for some Pokémon, once they’ve leveled up\nenough...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_09

entries.text: their appearance changes, and their stats\nincrease—sometimes by a lot![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_10

entries.text: That’s Pokémon Evolution![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_11

entries.text: Pokémon become very strong when they evolve,\nmaking them trusty partners in battle.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_12

entries.text: But! Some people prefer to keep their Pokémon\nin their adorable pre-evolved states.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_13

entries.text: To do this, you just need to remember a certain\nbutton when your Pokémon begins to evolve.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_14

entries.text: Say it with me if you already know! To cancel\nEvolution, press the...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_15

entries.text: A Button!
entries.label: class_a_05_select_01

entries.text: B Button!
entries.label: class_a_05_select_02

entries.text: C Button!
entries.label: class_a_05_select_03

entries.text:

The A Button has more of a decisive feel to it.
Kinda like “A-OK!” don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_answer_01

entries.text: That’s right, everyone! “B” for “best answer!”[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_answer_02

entries.text:

be
thinking
of
something else.\c
The C Button... That has a bit of a nostalgic feel
to it, don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_answer_03

entries.text: The button you want when you need to stop a\nPokémon from evolving is the B Button![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_16

entries.text: If you press this button soon after a Pokémon\nbegins to evolve, you can stop it from changing.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_17

entries.text: You can also let the Pokémon hold an item known\nas an Everstone to keep it from evolving.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_18

entries.text: And keep in mind that the requirements for\nEvolution differ from Pokémon to Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_19

entries.text:
Some may evolve by having a certain item, such
as a Fire Stone or Thunder Stone, used on them.\c
Others may have to learn a specific move or
defeat a specific Pokémon in battle to evolve.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_20

entries.text: The way Primeape evolves into Annihilape is\nespecially strange.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_21

entries.text: You see, there’s a certain move that—[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_22

entries.text: Whoops. Sorry, looks like we’re out of time![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_23

entries.text: I guess we’ll have to end the class there today.\nThank you all for your attention![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_05_ecology_24
